wiring.actual: BlueprintContract plus preview package_payload and implementation_checklist include these install units.
preview_blueprint calls preview_pack for workflow/dashboard/policy refs and preserves external_required; metadata/report/billing/offline changes are preview rows.
analyze_blueprint_impact surfaces roles, workflows, dashboards, policies, billing rules, external dependencies, and confirmation requirements.
apply_blueprint creates BlueprintInstallation, writes audit events, stores rollback snapshot, runs apply_package, and calls apply_pack for referenced packs with blueprint_installation linkage.
blueprint rollback view/service uses stored snapshot and audit posture; linked pack rollback is available through PackInstallation rollback.
preview_pack returns package payload/conflicts/external_required; preview mutation tests exist.
simulate_pack covers pack-specific scenario output and is used before apply for simulation-required packs.
apply_pack gates high-risk/platform-only packs, blocks failed previews/dependencies/missing simulations, stores snapshots, and creates PackInstallation.
rollback_pack_installation restores snapshot, rolls back package marker, audits; deactivate marks status without destructive deletion.
ConfigurationChangeRequest routes and services cover request, approve, reject, schedule, cancel, and apply; rollback posture is captured in change sets/installations.
administration_catalog.CONFIGURATION_MODULES enumerates all listed modules and configuration_center renders links without dummy hrefs.
TENANT_CONFIGURATION_SECTIONS lists tenant-safe sections; `/school/...` route aliases map apps, billing/money, workflows, offline, audit, and security to existing tenant-safe surfaces.
